title: DART — the crash that changed an asteroid's orbit

segments.en: We crashed a spacecraft into an asteroid. And moved it.
segments.en_cap: We crashed a spacecraft | into an asteroid. | And moved it.

segments.en: In twenty twenty-two, DART closed in at six point one kilometers per second.

segments.en: Contact. A spray of rock and dust blasted out from the surface into open space.
segments.en_cap: Contact. | A spray of rock and dust | blasted out | from the surface | into open space.

segments.en: Those escaping fragments pushed back against the asteroid. Their recoil amplified the spacecraft's shove.

segments.en: Over the following weeks, its orbit around Didymos settled into a faster loop.

segments.en: Thirty-three minutes and fifteen seconds shorter.
This asteroid posed no threat to Earth.
